other_conditions: The applicant must own private land.
Land area must be at least 0.25 hectares and not exceed 4 hectares.
The applicant must have adequate means of irrigation to support fruit plantation.
The applicant should be interested in growing fruit crops.
The applicant should have a strong interest in plantation activities.
benefits_summary: Subsidy of 40%–50% of the unit cost for fruit saplings, paid over three years in a 60:20:20 ratio.
